subject.title: fix(minimax): refresh default music model to music-3.0 and expand catalog

question: Should upgrades that rely on MiniMax’s automatic music-provider default move from `music-2.6` to `music-3.0` now?
rationale: The change is supported by MiniMax’s current API contract, but it intentionally changes behavior for existing unpinned configurations rather than only adding an opt-in model.

options.title: Adopt Music 3.0 as default
options.body: Accept the documented MiniMax recommendation after obtaining real after-fix provider proof and retain `music-2.6` as an explicit selectable model.

options.title: Keep the existing default
options.body: Leave automatic selection on `music-2.6` and expose `music-3.0` only as an explicit catalog choice until a broader upgrade decision is made.

recommendation.title: Adopt Music 3.0 as default
recommendation.body: Accept the documented MiniMax recommendation after obtaining real after-fix provider proof and retain `music-2.6` as an explicit selectable model.
